faq_heading: Port Coquitlam schools: your questions answered

blocks.text: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care school list shows 24 schools with a Port Coquitlam street address: 20 public schools and 4 independent schools. In that list, 10 schools marked as offering French Immersion and 1 Francophone school run by the Conseil scolaire francophone.

Public schools here are run by School District 43 (Coquitlam) and School District 93 (Conseil scolaire francophone). Count by district: School District 43 (Coquitlam): 19, School District 93 (Conseil scolaire francophone): 1.
Alternate programs, continuing education centres and online schools that have a street address sit under "other public schools and programs"; the level of every school is read from its name.
Public secondary schools with a Port Coquitlam address: Terry Fox Secondary and École Riverside Secondary.

The Ministry file marks these Port Coquitlam schools as offering French Immersion: École Citadel Middle, École Coquitlam River Elementary, École Irvine Elementary, École Kilmer Elementary, École Kwayhquitlum Middle, École Maple Creek Middle, École Mary Hill Elementary, École Pitt River Middle, École Riverside Secondary and École Westwood Elementary.
Independent schools listed for Port Coquitlam include Archbishop Carney Regional Secondary, British Columbia Christian Academy, Hope Lutheran Christian School and Our Lady of the Assumption.
Before an offer, ask the district which school serves the exact street address.
The Coquitlam school district publishes its catchments only as an interactive map, not as a list of streets. Use the district's own page to check an address:
Coquitlam school district catchments and school finder
The Conseil scolaire francophone publishes its attendance zones (zones de fréquentation) on its own site:
Conseil scolaire francophone attendance zones

faq.q: How many schools are in Port Coquitlam, BC?
faq.a: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care list shows 24 schools with a Port Coquitlam street address: 20 public schools and 4 independent schools. The count includes alternate programs and online schools that have a street address.

faq.q: Which school district covers Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: Public schools with a Port Coquitlam address are run by School District 43 (Coquitlam) and School District 93 (Conseil scolaire francophone).

faq.q: How do I find the catchment school for a Port Coquitlam address?
faq.a: Ask School District 43 (Coquitlam) and School District 93 (Conseil scolaire francophone) to confirm it for the exact street address.
